caption: The image is a drawing of a carved wooden statue depicting a standing human figure, dressed in clothing that includes a dark brown tunic with gold or yellow fringe at the bottom, and light tan pants. The figure has a round medallion on its chest, a sashed belt around the waist, and holds an object resembling a staff or club in its right hand, while the left hand is resting on the waist. Over the tunic, a tan or light yellow cape with a darker interior is draped over the figure's left shoulder. The statue wears a headdress with red and brown feathers and a light-colored band. The face is detailed with black eyes and a neutral expression. The statue stands on a rectangular block base and there are patches of visible wear or chipping on the surface, especially on the pants and cape. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Cigar Store Indian
